questions.question: A therapist palpates proximally along the second metacarpal. Which carpal bone does not articulate with the second metacarpal?
questions.explanation: The second metacarpal articulates with the trapezium, trapezoid and capitate but not the hamate.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A therapist palpates the proximal row of carpals in a patient diagnosed with carpal tunnel syndrome. Which of the following bones does not articulate with the proximal row of carpals?
questions.explanation: The ulna does not articulate directly with the proximal carpal row; the articular disc intervenes.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The 4th cranial nerve is named as:
questions.explanation: The fourth cranial nerve is the trochlear nerve, a motor nerve to superior oblique.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Neurology and Neurosurgery/Lindsay/4th Ed./Pg. 12

questions.question: Anterior interosseous nerve is a branch of which nerve?
questions.explanation: The anterior interosseous nerve is a branch of the median nerve.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The three main orifices in diaphragm:
questions.explanation: The three major openings of the diaphragm are for the aorta, oesophagus and inferior vena cava.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Injury to the lateral cord of the brachial plexus would most likely involve damage to the _____ nerve?
questions.explanation: The lateral cord gives the musculocutaneous nerve and contributes to the median nerve.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A physical therapist examines a 15 year old female distance runner for foot pain of unknown etiology. As the therapist palpates along the medial aspect of the foot and ankle, she palpates the head of the first metatarsal bone and the metatarsophalangeal joint. Immediately proximal to this she identifies the first cuneiform. What large bony prominence would you expect the therapist to identify next if she continues to move in a proximal direction?
questions.explanation: The navicular lies just proximal to the cuneiforms on the medial aspect of the foot.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed/Pg. 368

questions.question: The female urethra is:
questions.explanation: The female urethra is about 3.8 cm long.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Movements of the temporomandibular joint result chiefly from the action of the temporalis, masseter, and medial and lateral pterygoids. Which muscle does not assist in elevating the mandible?
questions.explanation: Temporalis, masseter and medial pterygoid elevate the mandible; lateral pterygoid protrudes and depresses it.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A therapist examines a patient referred to physical therapy diagnosed with a lateral collateral ligament sprain. Which nerve can be palpated immediately below the bead of the fibula.
questions.explanation: The common peroneal nerve winds around the neck of the fibula and is palpable just below the fibular head.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Human Anatomy/B.D. Chaurasia/Vol 2/4th Ed./Pg. 107

questions.question: A physical therapist reviews the medical record of a patient who sustained brachial plexus injury. The record states that the medial cord of the brachial plexus was partially severed. Which nerve would you expect to be the most seriously affected by the injury?
questions.explanation: The medial cord gives the ulnar nerve and the medial root of the median nerve; the axillary nerve comes from the posterior cord.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Human Anatomy/B.D. Chaurasia/Vol. 1/4th Ed./Pg. 52

questions.question: Tenderness elicited through palpation on the floor of the anatomic snuffbox can often be indicative of a fracture. A fracture in this area would likely involve the:
questions.explanation: Tenderness in the floor of the anatomical snuffbox suggests scaphoid fracture.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Avulsion fracture of the anterior inferior iliac spine is because of the violent contraction of the:
questions.explanation: The straight head of rectus femoris arises from the anterior inferior iliac spine and can avulse it.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Tectoral membrane is the continuation of:
questions.explanation: The tectorial membrane is the upward continuation of the posterior longitudinal ligament.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Following are the branches of posterior cord of branchial plexus except:
questions.explanation: The dorsal scapular nerve arises directly from the C5 root; the posterior cord gives the axillary, radial and subscapular/thoracodorsal nerves.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Yellow elastic cartilage is present in:
questions.explanation: Elastic cartilage forms the epiglottis and external ear.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Middle mediastinum contains the following structure except:
questions.explanation: The azygos vein lies in the posterior mediastinum; the middle mediastinum contains the heart, pericardium, ascending aorta, pulmonary trunk and phrenic nerves.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The distal articular surface of the ankle joint is made up of:
questions.explanation: The superior articular surface of the talus (its body) is the distal component of the ankle joint.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The rotator cuff is composed of four of the following muscles except:
questions.explanation: The rotator cuff is supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis; teres major is not part of it.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Replacement of calcified articular cartilage by bone occurs by:
questions.explanation: Calcified cartilage is replaced by bone through endochondral ossification.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The function of costoclavicular ligament is checking of __________ movement.
questions.explanation: The costoclavicular ligament limits elevation of the clavicle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The structure attach to the periphery of the glenoid cavity is called as _______ .
questions.explanation: The glenoid labrum is a fibrocartilaginous rim around the glenoid cavity that deepens it.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The ligament that extends from the inferior edge of ulnar's radial notch to insert in the neck at radius is:
questions.explanation: The quadrate ligament runs from the radial notch of the ulna to the neck of the radius.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Cubital tunnel syndrome can be caused by repetitive contraction of:
questions.explanation: The ulnar nerve passes under the aponeurosis of flexor carpi ulnaris in the cubital tunnel and can be compressed there.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following does not have the blood supply?
questions.explanation: Articular cartilage is avascular and gets nutrition by diffusion from synovial fluid.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The coracoacromial arch prevents the dislocation of the humerus:
questions.explanation: The coraco-acromial arch prevents upward (superior) displacement of the humeral head.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A thin area of capsule between superior and middle glenohumeral ligament is:
questions.explanation: The foramen of Weitbrecht is the gap between the superior and middle glenohumeral ligaments.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Group of fiber bundles enclosed by a loose connective tissue sheath is called:
questions.explanation: Endotenon is the connective tissue sheath enclosing groups of collagen fibre bundles within a tendon.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The statement regarding posterior cruciate ligament is:

options.A: Attached to medial surface of lateral condyle
options.D: Relaxed during the flexion of knee

questions.explanation: The posterior cruciate ligament prevents posterior displacement of the tibia on the femur.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: ______ muscle prevents unwanted micturition and defecation.
questions.explanation: Levator ani supports the pelvic viscera and helps maintain urinary and faecal continence.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Strongest ligament in the hip is:
questions.explanation: The iliofemoral (Y ligament of Bigelow) is the strongest ligament in the body.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The term ankle specifically refers to:
questions.explanation: The ankle joint proper is the talocrural (tibiotalar) joint.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which movement of the shoulder gets restricted when supraspinatus torn?
questions.explanation: Supraspinatus initiates abduction, so a tear weakens/restricts active abduction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Brachioradialis muscle is supplied by:
questions.explanation: Brachioradialis is supplied by the radial nerve.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Ulnar nerve supplies following muscle in the forearm:
questions.explanation: In the forearm the ulnar nerve supplies flexor carpi ulnaris and the medial half of flexor digitorum profundus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: By which structure we check the downward pull of gravity on arm by the side?
questions.explanation: The superior capsule and coracohumeral ligament resist downward pull of the arm in the resting position.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin /4th Ed./Pg. 249

questions.question: In neutral standing position hip joint is weaker:
questions.explanation: The hip capsule is thinnest anteriorly with the least muscular support in neutral standing.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Kinesiology of MusculoskeletalSystem/ Neumann/1st Ed./Pg. 396

questions.question: The function of meniscus is ___________.
questions.explanation: Menisci absorb shock, distribute load, aid lubrication and nutrition and improve joint congruity.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 329

questions.question: You are evaluating a 26-year-old male patient status post arthroscopic surgery. The physician requests that you evaluate the muscles that insert into the pes anserinus. You have the patient flex the knee and medially rotate the leg while the knee is flexed. Of the muscles listed below, which are you not evaluating?
questions.explanation: The pes anserinus is formed by sartorius, gracilis and semitendinosus; semimembranosus does not insert there.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which muscle is the little helper of latissimus dorsi?
questions.explanation: Teres major is the 'little helper' of latissimus dorsi, with a similar action of extension, adduction and medial rotation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter:
Cited reference: Human Anatomy B. D. Chaurasia Vol-1/

4th Ed./Pg. 146

questions.question: You are treating a patient secondary to a foot injury. The patient reports that his pediatrist thought the spring ligament was injured as a result of his fall. Which of the following best describes the spring ligament of the foot?

options.A: It is also called the plantar calcaneocuboid ligament
options.B: It is called the short plantar ligament
options.C: It helps to maintain the medial arch of the foot by supporting the head of talipes
options.D: The spring ligament is not highly elastic

questions.explanation: The spring (plantar calcaneonavicular) ligament supports the head of the talus and the medial longitudinal arch.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 371

questions.question: A patient is sent to physical therapy secondary to a lower extremity injury. Reading the patient's past medical history, you note that the superficial peroneal nerve has been severed. Which of the following muscles would be emphasized in your treatment program?
questions.explanation: The superficial peroneal nerve supplies peroneus longus and brevis; tibialis anterior and EHL are supplied by the deep peroneal nerve.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Human Anatomy BD Chaurasia/4th Ed./Pg. 160

questions.question: A butcher is responsible for processing meat packaging. In the process of carving the meat he injures the second and third digits of his hand. The hand surgeon reports that the nerves in the second and third digits have been permanently injured. Which nerve/nerves would be injured?
questions.explanation: The median nerve supplies sensation to the index and middle fingers (digits 2 and 3) on the palmar side.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Human Anatomy B. D. Chaurasia/4th Ed./Pg. 111

questions.question: When performing ultrasound on a patient it is important to be aware of contraindications for its utilization. One contraindication is performing ultrasound over the epiphyseal or growth plate of a child. Which of the following statements is not true concerning the growth plate?

options.A: It serves as a site of progressive lengthening that is needed in the long bones
options.B: It lies between the epiphysis and diaphysis as a transverse disk
options.D: It is found in all bones

questions.explanation: Epiphyseal growth plates occur in long bones, not in all bones.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Low and Reed/3rd Ed./Pg. 200

questions.question: A muscle is known to have a proximal and distal attachment. It is necessary to know the attachments for palpation and manual muscle tests. Which of the following is the proximal attachment of a limb muscle?
questions.explanation: The origin is the usual proximal attachment of a limb muscle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 96

questions.question: A therapist an inservice to the rehabilitation staff on the anatomy of the spine. As part of the presentation the therapist discusses the role of each of the ligaments of the spine. Which ligament of the spine acts to prevent hyperextension?
questions.explanation: The anterior longitudinal ligament resists hyperextension.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 122

questions.question: Cartilage is quite vascular in:
questions.explanation: Cartilage is most vascular in embryonic life.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Essential of Orthopedicss/Jayant Joshi/Reprint 2006/Pg. 406

questions.question: Osteophytes developing at the joint at Luscka characteristically compress spinal nerves at:
questions.explanation: Osteophytes at the uncovertebral (Luschka) joints compress nerves in the intervertebral foramen.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The rotator cuff of the gleno humeral joint is formed by the tendons of:

options.A: Supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres major and latissimus dorsi
options.B: Infraspinatus, subscapularis, latissimus dorsi and pectoralis major
options.C: Teres minor, subscapularis, latissimus dorsi and pectoralis major
options.D: Teres minor, infraspinatus, supraspinatus and subscapularis

questions.explanation: The rotator cuff is supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 220

questions.question: Deltoid muscle is supplied by:
questions.explanation: The deltoid is supplied by the axillary nerve (C5-C6).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Loss of active extension of metacarpophalangeal joint occurs in the injury of which of the following nerves?
questions.explanation: Posterior interosseous nerve injury loses MCP extension but spares wrist extension.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter:
Cited reference: Essential of Orthopedicss of Applied Physiotherapy/

Jayant Joshi/Pg. 262

questions.question: Wrist drop occurs in radial nerve injury of all levels except:
questions.explanation: Wrist drop occurs in radial nerve injury at all levels except distal to the elbow.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: All the following are correct about clavicle except:

options.A: Only long bone in body to ossify in membrane
options.B: Only long bone in body which connects limb to axial skeleton
options.C: Only long bone in body to ossify in intrauterine life
options.D: Only long bone in body to ossify by endochondral ossification

questions.explanation: The clavicle ossifies in membrane, not by endochondral ossification only.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Crazy bone or crazy nerve contusion is associated with:

options.C: Radial nerve at spiral groove in humerus

questions.explanation: Contusion of the ulnar nerve at the elbow is the "funny bone" injury.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Brachioradialis muscle is paralyzed in radial nerve injuries of all the following levels except:
questions.explanation: Brachioradialis is spared by radial nerve injury distal to the elbow.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A patient sustains an injury to the dorsal scapular nerve. Which muscle not innervated by this nerve can elevate the scapula?
questions.explanation: Trapezius is supplied by the accessory nerve, not the dorsal scapular nerve.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: While palpating the wrist and hand, it should become apparent that the hamate articulates with the ________ metacarpal?
questions.explanation: The hamate articulates with the fourth (and fifth) metacarpal.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A therapist reviews the medical record of a patient with a peripheral nerve injury. The most common site for an ulnar never is the:

options.C: Superficial surface of the flexor retinaculum

questions.explanation: The ulnar nerve is most often injured behind the medial epicondyle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: If the radial nerve is severed above the origin of the triceps muscle, what motion of the elbow joint in impossible?
questions.explanation: A radial nerve lesion above the triceps abolishes elbow extension.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A forearm laceration causes damage to the median nerve. Which muscle not innervated by the media nerve can flex the wrist?
questions.explanation: Flexor carpi ulnaris flexes the wrist and is supplied by the ulnar nerve.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A patient sustained a knife would which severed the distal lateral cord of the brachial plexus EMG testing reveals no damage to the median nerve. The injury will likely result in impairment of:
questions.explanation: A lateral cord injury impairs elbow flexion and forearm supination (musculocutaneous).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: If the axillary nerve was severed, what muscle could laterally rotate the humerus?
questions.explanation: With axillary nerve damage infraspinatus can still laterally rotate the humerus.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A physical therapist palpates the muscle bellies of the wrist extensors. The therapist follows the muscles proximally to their common origin. This bony landmark is termed the:
questions.explanation: The wrist extensors arise from the lateral epicondyle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A therapist palpates the bony structures of the wrist and hand. Which of the following structures would not be identified in the distal row of carpals?
questions.explanation: The triquetrum is in the proximal row; capitate, hamate and trapezoid are distal.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 252

questions.question: A physical therapist examines a patient with a dorsal scapular nerve injury. Which muscles would you expect to be most affected by this condition?
questions.explanation: Levator scapulae and the rhomboids are supplied by the dorsal scapular nerve.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The lesion in Klumpke's paralysis is at:
questions.explanation: Klumpke's paralysis is a lower brachial plexus lesion.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Dorsum of the middle finger is supplied by:
questions.explanation: The dorsum of the middle finger is supplied by radial and median nerves.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Sensory supply of the tip of the ring fingers:
questions.explanation: The tip of the ring finger is supplied by the median nerve (radial half) in this source.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Sprengel's deformity of scapula is:
questions.explanation: Sprengel's deformity is an elevated, undescended scapula.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Orthopedic Physical Assesment/Magee/5th Ed./Pg. 544

questions.question: All are components of rotator cuff except:
questions.explanation: Teres major is not a rotator cuff muscle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Brachialis is supplied by:
questions.explanation: Brachialis is supplied by the musculocutaneous and radial nerves.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Extension of the metacarpophalangeal joint is lost in injury to:
questions.explanation: MCP extension is lost in posterior interosseous nerve injury.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Piriformis muscle is inserted at:
questions.explanation: Piriformis inserts into the greater trochanter.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/3rd Ed./Pg. 312

questions.question: Loss of active dorsiflexion of ankle occurs in the injury of which of the following nerves?
questions.explanation: Loss of active ankle dorsiflexion follows sciatic (common peroneal) nerve injury.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Essential of Orthopedicsss/Jayant Joshi/Pg. 262

questions.question: Loss of active knee extension occurs in the injury of which of the following nerves?
questions.explanation: Loss of active knee extension follows femoral nerve injury.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Essentials of Orthopedics/Jayant Joshi/Pg. 262

questions.question: Inversion of foot occurs at:
questions.explanation: Inversion and eversion occur at the subtalar joint.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Joint Structure and Function/Norkin/Pg. 376

questions.question: The head of femur receives blood supply from:
questions.explanation: The femoral head is supplied mainly by the medial and lateral circumflex femoral arteries.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Human Anatomy/BD Chaurasia/Vol. 2/4th Ed./Pg. 56

questions.question: Length growth of bone is accomplished by:
questions.explanation: Longitudinal bone growth occurs at the epiphyseal growth plate.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The first bone to ossify in fetal life is:
questions.explanation: The clavicle is the first bone to ossify.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: The following bone is a pneumatic bone:
questions.explanation: The maxilla contains an air sinus and is a pneumatic bone.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
